name: zz-core
description: ZZ platform baseline — identity, your team's documents and knowledge, the gates, and where each piece of work stands. Required by everything else.
purpose: To own the record every flow writes into — identity, documents, gates, knowledge, telemetry, and what anybody reports broken — and the method for using it. A capability belongs here when every flow needs it and no flow owns it; anything one flow owns belongs in that flow. Filing a defect and answering one are the same subject and live together here; which half you are offered is your role's answer, not the door's.
